en_title: Dev Behind Russian Roulette Drinking Game Cancels Steam Demo Plans Following AI Copycat Concerns
cn_title: 担忧AI仿作，饮酒游戏取消公开试玩
subtitle: 试玩转为封闭限额
opus_summary: 俄轮盘饮酒游戏开发团队担忧有人用AI复制玩法与表现形式，并抢先发售，因此取消原定十月十九日推出的公开试玩。团队将改办限额封闭试玩，游戏仍定于十二月八日发售。

paragraphs.en: The developer behind Russian roulette anime game Drunken Goddess Reflux has canceled its plans for a public Steam demo, citing concerns over potential AI copycats.
paragraphs.cn: 二次元俄轮盘游戏《Drunken Goddess Reflux》的开发团队担心出现AI仿作，取消了在Steam推出公开试玩版的计划。

paragraphs.en: Alliance Arts and Who You's path to launch has seemingly been mostly bump-free since it was announced back in April. Featuring ghostly pinks and purples and a gameplay premise described as "shot glass Russian roulette with a demon who loves you enough to kill you," the recent reveal that it would launch this December only made its future feel clearer.
paragraphs.cn: 自4月公布以来，Alliance Arts与Who You这款作品的发售之路似乎一直颇为顺利。游戏采用幽魅的粉紫色调，玩法被描述为「与一个爱你爱到愿意杀死你的恶魔，用烈酒杯玩俄轮盘」。最近公布的12月发售消息，也让它的前景显得更加明朗。

paragraphs.en: Part of that release date announcement included the promise that a demo would launch October 19, but as explained in an update post on Steam , those plans have changed. What was originally intended to be a public release for the Drunken Goddess Reflux demo has now been canceled in favor of a "closed play session for a limited number of participants." It's a last-minute move Alliance Arts apologized for, but its concerns related to rapidly advancing AI technology were simply too great to ignore.
paragraphs.cn: 公布发售日期时，团队还承诺将在10月19日推出试玩版，但正如Steam更新公告所述，计划如今已有变化。《Drunken Goddess Reflux》原定公开发布的试玩版已被取消，改为「仅限少量参与者的封闭试玩活动」。Alliance Arts为这一临时变动致歉，但AI技术飞速发展带来的顾虑，实在让团队无法忽视。

paragraphs.en: "We are concerned that, based on the content of the demo, works imitating or replicating this game's presentation and gameplay could be quickly produced using AI or other tools and released ahead of the game's launch," the developers said in their list of concerns.
paragraphs.cn: 开发团队在列举顾虑时表示：「我们担心，有人可能根据试玩版的内容，使用AI或其他工具快速制作出模仿或复制本作表现形式与玩法的作品，并赶在本作发售之前推出。」

paragraphs.en: In other words, sending a demo out into the wild could open the door for nefarious individuals to use AI to generate a low-effort clone or copycat experience. For a team hoping for a successful launch in just a few months, someone coming in to steal its thunder could potentially throw a wrench into things.
paragraphs.cn: 换句话说，公开发布试玩版，可能让心怀不轨的人有机会利用AI，粗制滥造地生成复制品或仿作。团队希望游戏能在几个月后顺利发售，若有人抢先推出仿作、抢走风头，计划就可能受到干扰。

paragraphs.en: Alliance Arts' fears emerge amid a time when AI is seeping into the gaming industry in ways most may not have ever expected. For example, mods – including mashups of Elden Ring and Super Mario 64 or Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 and Skate – have regularly gone viral on social media in recent weeks. With the controversial technology expanding in new, unforeseen ways every day, it's a risk the Drunken Goddess Reflux weren't willing to take.
paragraphs.cn: Alliance Arts产生这些担忧之际，AI正以大多数人可能从未料想过的方式渗入游戏行业。例如，近几周，各种模组频频在社交媒体上走红，其中就有将《艾尔登法环》与《超级马力欧64》混搭，以及将《使命召唤：现代战争2》与《Skate》混搭的作品。这项备受争议的技术每天都在以难以预料的新方式扩展应用，《Drunken Goddess Reflux》团队不愿冒这个险。

paragraphs.en: Another bullet point concern listed in its message detailed restrictions on posting and streaming gameplay videos, but as the team explained, they "are not currently in a position to properly handle and manage those restrictions." With limited resources to keep nearly unrestricted access to a demo in check, Alliance Arts is moving forward with that closed demo.
paragraphs.cn: 公告列出的另一条顾虑涉及发布实机视频及直播游戏的限制，但团队解释称，他们「目前尚无力妥善处理和管理这些限制」。试玩版一旦几乎不设门槛地向公众开放，Alliance Arts也没有足够资源加以管理，因此决定采用封闭试玩的方式。

paragraphs.en: "We will therefore hold online play sessions in a closed environment," the developer added, "open to those who have reviewed and agreed in advance to the participation requirements and the rules on posting and streaming gameplay videos."
paragraphs.cn: 开发团队补充道：「因此，我们将在封闭环境中举办线上试玩活动，仅向事先阅读并同意参与要求，以及实机视频发布和游戏直播规则的玩家开放。」

paragraphs.en: Players interested in trying the demonic drinking game out were encouraged to join the Discord server presented in the Steam post. Otherwise, Drunken Goddess Reflux is still scheduled to launch on PC via Steam December 8, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 团队鼓励有兴趣体验这款恶魔饮酒游戏的玩家，加入Steam公告中提供的Discord服务器。除此之外，《Drunken Goddess Reflux》仍计划于2026年12月8日在Steam发售，登陆PC。
